chapter_title: The Theft of the Rimet Cup
title: Confluence of the Routes
subtitle: It all leads to the same answer.

trails.title: Mayor Holding A New Event
trails.description: A record of the interview to the Mayor.

items.speaker: Newsboy
items.text: Extra! Extra! The event about to change London!
Someone suddenly appears from behind him and taps him gently on the shoulder.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hey, Tommy! Long time no see.

items.speaker: Newsboy
items.text: Regulus?! Why are you here!

items.speaker: Newsboy
items.text: I met you the day before. You show up so often these days.

items.speaker: Newsboy
items.text: Did you get rid of those scouts?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ha! They don't have time for me right now.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Yesterday, Captain Regulus encountered a weirdo.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Right. Ragged lad claimed to have left us his last words in the newspaper.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Captain, I'm afraid what he said was "surprising note."

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh, never mind. It doesn't matter! Tommy, what's on the front page today?

items.speaker: Newsboy
items.text: Here, see for yourself!
He gives Regulus the crumpled newspaper that has been looked over by many people.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: "The Rimet Cup Exhibition starts today. Carnival for Fans!"
Mr. APPLe suspends his new research on the translator and drifts to Regulus.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: "New Humans has announced to undertake the Rimet Cup Exhibition. More security robots will be put into use to replace human jobs ..."

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: "If all goes well, the security system will be introduced to the police after the exhibition. London will embrace real peace."

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: "Far more reliable than humans, meticulous enforcers, and all-round urban security landscape."

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: It seems London will tighten the regulations. The government plans to launch security robots.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Stubborn tin monsters?!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Yes. According to the description on newspapers, those robots can block out mobile signals and change the regional magnetic field.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: I'm afraid our broadcast will be affected.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Can we still "borrow" others' radio waves?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Huuhh! Of course, we can't.
Regulus crumples the newspaper in her hand.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ugh! Crap!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: What kind of surprising note is this! If the robots take over London, my plans for a pirate's gig will go down the drain!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: New Humans ... Oh, I get it. Ragged lad is part of the robots team, or maybe even a badass boss trying to take control of London!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: No wonder he seems to have a problem with the cops. Ugh!

items.speaker: Newsboy
items.text: Blimey! This one is huge!

items.speaker: Newsboy
items.text: Are you going to provide your first hand to the press? They must be interested.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Never mind. He saved us once, after all. A friend will persuade him to abandon this evil plan.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Captain Regulus will never forget friendship for profit!

items.speaker: Newsboy
items.text: Damn shame. That's a heap of dosh. You could even get your cycle some fancy equipment.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Tell me first. How much do they pay?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Captain.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ahem! I-I was just curious! Just kidding!
Regulus gives the crumpled newspaper back to Tommy.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I have to go and do something more important now.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Cheers, Tommy.

items.speaker: Newsboy
items.text: Bye! I'm here if you change your mind!
The brand new newspaper is crumpled into a ball by Diggers and is then suddenly unfolded.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: "Breaking! Gemini 8 Conducted First Manual Docking in Space."

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: "Fifth Fluffy Sports Meeting is coming. Interested candidates, please sign up with your pet."
He flips the newspaper over and over.
Thank God. He finally finds what he's hoping to see in the gap between the two pages of news.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: "Police Notice: A man controlled a watering car with special means and deliberately violated public transit. He will be detained for three days as a punishment."

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: How come?!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Party theme, the key points of my speech, host, future trend of art ...

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: None are mentioned!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Hahh! A brand-new world was born yesterday, but most people don't have a chance to celebrate.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Gloomy clouds haunt the sky of my Utopia. Shame on London! Shame on the world!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: We need to change! Radical change!
Diggers pounds his chest with indignation and lifts the newspaper high. He paces back and forth, just like an ambitious poet.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: We won't be corrupted by entertainment. The bell of art will break the shackles of the stubbornness.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: London has been trapped in a long and dreadful night. What it needs is the sun, not the dull stars.
After turning around twenty-seven times and a half, he finally stops.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: The deserted street won't attract many people.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: They have been used to following the crowd. They can only spot the noticeable objects!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: We must throw a grand party of art, to topple the mainstream, to blow more people's minds!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: And it shouldn't be contained only to streets ...

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: I get it! I get it! The eye-catching exhibition hall of the Rimet Cup will become the unprecedented, the craziest, and the perfect stage!
Diggers leaves with excitement. The newspaper is tossed into the air, signaling the start of a good show.

items.speaker: Wendy
items.text: Woof woof!
A well-trained pup will never miss a single chance to catch a flying ball.
Of course, the newspaper in the air is included.
TO BE CONTINUED ...
